T: Skipping Christmas? Not with this ham.
D: A couple try to skip Christmas for a cruise until their daughter says she is coming home after all.
P: Serve the main when Nora finally gets her hands on the last ham.
S: the Frosty the whole street wants on their roof
A cheese ball shaped like a snowman, rolled in white cheese with olive buttons and a carrot nose.
the Caribbean cruise they almost take
Cold prawns on ice with cocktail sauce, the cruise ship buffet starter Luther was saving up for.
M: Nora's race for the last ham in town
A smoked ham with a sticky honey glaze, the one Nora fights another shopper for on Christmas Eve.
W: Sponge, raspberry jelly, custard and cream layered in a big glass bowl for a party thrown together in hours.
K: the whole street pitching in for the party
Cranberry and orange punch topped up with lemonade over ice.

s.note: the Frosty the whole street wants on their roof
s.how: Mix 400g cream cheese with 150g grated mozzarella and shape into two balls stacked like a snowman. Press in olive buttons and eyes and a little carrot nose. Serve with 200g crackers.

s.note: the Caribbean cruise they almost take
s.how: Pile 500g cooked prawns on a platter of ice. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 2 tbsp tomato sauce and a squeeze of lemon for the cocktail sauce and serve with lemon wedges.

m.note: Nora's race for the last ham in town
m.how: Score a 2kg smoked ham and brush with a glaze of 100g honey, 50g brown sugar and 2 tbsp Dijon. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes, glazing every 15 minutes until sticky and dark.

w.how: Make raspberry jelly and let it half set. Tear a sponge cake into a glass bowl, pour over the jelly and chill until firm. Top with 500ml custard and 300ml whipped cream.

d.note: the whole street pitching in for the party
d.how: Mix 1L cranberry juice and 500ml orange juice in a jug with orange slices. Top with 500ml lemonade just before serving and pour over plenty of ice.
